messages:
alex: Quick note — found a handful of /embed requests where emails slipped into telemetry exports. low volume but reproducible. :grimacing:

maria: ugh. which tenants and routes?

alex: mostly realtime /v1/embed, a couple tenants, mix of SDK + direct calls. client scrub misses odd shorthand.
devon: short-term: ingress should strip PII. long-term: encrypt raw and only expose redacted copies; unmask via audited flow.
jess: console UX: redacted preview by default, "Request full view" modal with justification and 2FA, auto-reseal after 60m.
sam: also need quota-aware sampling — base low, spike on anomalies, tenant daily cap to control cost.
maria: i'll push a simple regex to canary ingress: `re.sub(r"[\w._%+-]+@[\w.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", payload)` and add redaction_misses metric.
devon: client hints ok (X-Redact-Hint) but treat as advisory only; server-side determinism required.
infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy ingress-scrubber v3 -> prod/us-west-2 (build 6810).
alex: actions: devon+rohan RFC for quota-aware sampler + delayed-unmask (EOW), jess mock unmask UX (Tue), sam estimate cost impact, maria enable regex canary. if high-severity leaks found, pause embeddings telemetry export until controls in place. :thumbsup:
